EPDM compound datasheets and gasket profiles are issued on request, under NDA where required. Tell us the flange standard and the medium — DXF or PDF for the profile — and we will send what we hold.
What is the minimum order quantity for this part?

We supply in bulk. The minimum run is 10,000 pieces per part number, per compound, or quoted against the part where geometry or tooling makes that unrealistic. Prototype and first-article lots sit outside the minimum.
Can you match a competitor specification or reverse-engineer an existing part?

Yes. Send the sample gasket or the flange standard and nominal bore. An in-service gasket has taken a compression set and measures thinner than it was cut — we specify to the original thickness, not to the compressed sample.
What file formats do you accept for drawings?
PDF, DWG and DXF. For a flange gasket the standard and the nominal bore are often enough — ASME B16.21, AWWA C111 or EN 681-1 — and we will cut to the dimensional tables. A 3D model is not required.
Do you provide material test reports with each shipment?

Yes. Material test reports, dimensional inspection sheets and a certificate of conformance ship with every consignment. Hardness, tensile to ASTM D412 and compression set to ASTM D395 Method B are tested in-house.
What are your payment and delivery terms for international orders?
TT and LC accepted, discussed per order. Ex-works Nashik or FOB Nhava Sheva. Commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin are issued with every consignment.
